jobs.title: Associate Project Manager - Canada
jobs.description:
About Very

(Remote - Canada)

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind — working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

About This Role

A Project Manager at Very plays a central role in ensuring our teams deliver on that promise. You’ll coordinate software, hardware, design, and data engineering efforts to keep programs running smoothly and predictably. You’ll help keep the team aligned, the client informed, and the delivery on track.

As an Associate Project Manager, you’ll join a team that takes client success personally. You’ll learn how to manage timelines, scope, and communication across complex technical projects — from connected devices to custom digital platforms. You’ll be supported by senior program leaders but will be expected to take real ownership early, learning how to create structure, bring clarity, and drive progress.

Success in this role means communicating proactively and ensuring our clients always have the context they need to make informed decisions. You’ll help build confidence through transparency, accuracy, and follow-through.

This is not an easy role. You’ll be managing ambiguity, solving problems in real time, and supporting teams that move fast. But if you find satisfaction in building systems that work, communicating with precision, and helping clients win — you’ll love it here.

As a client services organization, travel may be required up to 10% of the time.

What You’ll Be Working On

Every engagement at Very is different, but they share one common theme: we build things that matter. From connected hardware and data systems to large-scale web and IoT platforms, you’ll:

Support multiple engineering and design teams, ensuring alignment on goals, priorities, and deliverables
Maintain schedules, track dependencies, and help manage program risks
Communicate clearly and proactively with clients — ensuring they always have the right information to stay confident in the project’s direction
Learn to balance scope, budget, and timelines under real-world constraints
Partner with senior project and program managers to strengthen Very’s delivery practices
Help facilitate sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives
Support proposal development and planning for upcoming client engagements.

You’ll operate in a multidisciplinary environment that includes:

Software: Modern web and cloud platforms (React, Node.js, Python and more))
Hardware: Connected device and embedded systems teams
Data Science & AI: Machine learning, analytics, and intelligent system design
Design: Industrial, UI and process design
Project Tools: Jira, Slack, Github, and cloud-based documentation system

Outcomes

Project Visibility: Maintain clear, accurate progress tracking across all assigned client projects
Delivery Confidence: Support the delivery team in achieving on-time, high-quality outcomes that meet or exceed client expectations
Operational Clarity: Communicate proactively so clients always have the information and context they need — and never feel out of the loop
Professional Growth: Develop the communication, planning, and leadership skills required to manage your own programs within 12–18 months
Client Trust: Build credibility with clients through responsiveness, organization, and consistent follow-through

Responsibilities

Support project planning, coordination, and execution across multiple technical disciplines
Maintain documentation, schedules, and deliverable trackers for assigned engagements
Communicate clearly with clients and internal teams on status, blockers, and next steps
Proactively surface risks or scope changes — and communicate them early to maintain alignment
Participate in client and internal project meetings; capture actions and ensure follow-through
Learn and apply Very’s standard delivery frameworks for agile, iterative work
Participate in retrospectives and help identify process improvements

Minimum Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

Experience

1–3 years of professional experience in a technical or project environment
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable working in fast-paced, client-facing environments
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively on cross-functional teams
Ability to work with modern AI-based tools

Technical Proficiency

Familiarity with modern engineering workflows (Git, Agile tools, cloud services)
Ability to learn and communicate technical concepts quickly
Proficiency in Google Workspace and common project management tools (Jira, Notion, etc.)

Skills

Client Obsessed: Ensures clients always have the right information, context, and confidence in delivery
Communicates Clearly: Translates complexity into clarity for both internal and external stakeholders
Thrives in the Grind: Finds satisfaction in the details that make complex work run smoothly
Learns Relentlessly: Grows fast, asks good questions, and applies lessons quickly
Brings Structure: Creates order and clarity in dynamic, technical environments

Compensation

Base Compensation:

CAD $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience.

Variable Compensation:

Up to 5%.

Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside in Canada and have proper work authorization. We do not sponsor work visas

Perks & Benefits:

Group RRSP match (Employer contributes 4% of your annual income)
Extended healthcare, dental, and vision insurance
$150 USD/mo cell/internet stipend
$600 USD/yr home office equipment stipend
Continuing education stipend ($2,500 USD/yr after one year)
Loaned MacBook Pro and other necessary equipment

Why Work for Very

We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work.

We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well.

If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very.

Important:

We don't currently provide Visa Sponsorship. Don't apply if you require this
This job is remote but if you’re not located in the region or country mentioned in the post’s title, do not continue. Your application won’t be reviewed

Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously.

jobs.title: Xformative - Client Project Manager
jobs.description:
Xformative Payment Systems
is a late stage start up that was conceptualized and established to offer card based and payment product capabilities associated with healthcare and benefits. The business is entering its growth phase and will be expanding beyond its current markets. At XPS, every member of our small, agile team can drive and create impactful work. Our flexible and fully remote work setup allows you to balance your professional and personal life seamlessly while contributing to our exciting growth journey.

We are looking for an experienced Client Project Manager
to lead the successful onboarding and implementation of new client contracts from project kickoff through go-live.
As our first Project Manager of Client Implementation, you will have the opportunity to help shape the implementation function. You'll establish best practices, processes, and create a client focused function that delivers an exceptional experience while driving operational excellence.
Working closely with all internal and external stakeholders, you'll serve as the central point of coordination throughout each implementation, ensuring projects remain on schedule, stakeholders stay aligned, and every milestone is successfully achieved.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are energized by building new processes while delivering outstanding client experiences, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Lead end-to-end implementation of new client programs, managing timelines, deliverables, and dependencies from project initiation through successful go-live.
Serve as the primary liaison with client stakeholders during onboarding to gather, document, and validate business and operational requirements.
Assess and confirm alignment between client requirements and existing system and operational capabilities; identify gaps and required enhancements.
Translate identified gaps into actionable workstreams and coordinate with Product, Technology, and Operations teams to initiate and track required development and operational changes.
Drive cross-functional coordination across internal teams (Operations, Product, Technology, Relationship Management) to ensure alignment, accountability, and timely execution.
Coordinate onboarding activities with external partners, including sponsor bank, network, and fulfillment vendors, ensuring completion of required documentation, approvals, and setup activities.
Manage program setup and readiness activities, including configuration, workflow validation, and operational preparedness for launch.
Track and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and key milestones to stakeholders and leadership; proactively identify and address potential issues.
Ensure all required documentation, approvals, and operational readiness criteria are completed prior to go-live.
Support transition from implementation to ongoing operations, ensuring a smooth handoff to Operations Support and Relationship Management teams.
Maintain organized project documentation, including requirements, decisions, timelines, and deliverables, to support transparency and future reference.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
4–8 years of experience in project management, client implementation, operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following industries is highly preferred:
Payments
Card programs
Financial services
Banking
Financial technology (FinTech)

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:
Excels at building relationships and collaborating with clients, leaders, and cross-functional teams.
Confidently engages with stakeholders at every level to elicit, analyze, challenge, and validate business, operational, and technical requirements
Can quickly understand business and operational requirements and translate them into actionable implementation plans.
Thrives managing multiple, complex projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying risks before they become issues.
Takes ownership for advancing our projects and enjoys rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.
Adapts easily to changing priorities and remains calm under pressure.
Is excited by the opportunity to build new processes, improve workflows, and help define a growing implementation organization.

CORPORATE CORE COMPETENCIES:

Drive Action & Results

Take on new opportunities with enthusiasm
Achieve results even in tough circumstances
Take personal accountability for decisions and actions
Adapt to Change

Operate effectively when things are uncertain
Proactively acquire and evaluate information and adapt approach to match shifting demands/situations
Rebound from setbacks
Embrace Innovation

Create new and better ways to approach challenges and develop solutions
Learn through experimentation
Encourage feedback and seek opportunities to work better/smarter/faster
Show personal commitment and take action to continuously improve
Create Diversity & Foster Collaboration

Actively bring, seek, engage, and honor diverse perspectives
Identify and address barriers to inclusion to ensure equity and center belonging
Work collaboratively and build partnerships to meet shared objectives

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
While this is primarily a sedentary role, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is also required to sit, stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

by XPS employees and representatives for only its intended purpose.

to join their team for 40 hours a week through March 2027!

- 3+ years of hands on experience in owning planning and execution of complex initiatives across product and engineering 
- Experience working in software or technical environments 
- Proven ability to establish and maintain clear plans, timelines and delivery milestones 
- Strong Jira, Confluence and Agile experience 
- Scope management experience
- Evaluating metrics to track project performance 
- Controlling schedule and budget impacts
- Ability to mitigate risks proactively

The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for: 

- Drive end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives by translating business priorities into clear plans and proactively managing risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs

- Lead delivery with structure and rigor, establishing timelines, tracking progress against outcomes, and removing blockers to keep teams moving efficiently

jobs.title: Project Manager, Services (Remote)
jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Services Project Manager will provide support to the SOLV team and will be responsible for newly onboarded PV Power Plants, ensuring peak performance of financials coupled with full compliance of all contractual obligations. The Project Manager will play a leadership role within the organization and work closely with all stakeholders to provide best in class fleet operations.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

Able to perform Business Operations Coordinator role responsibilities (refer to position descriptions).
Negotiate cost-effective subcontract and material purchases.
Manage subcontractors and vendors to ensure their compliance with contract terms, scope of work, and schedule.
Develop and maintain good relationship with Owners, subcontractors and SOLV team.
Encourage positive relationships between SOLV field teams and the Owners through conversation.
Support SOLV Field team to meet contractual terms, maximize plant production and availability, and enhance fee.
Responsible for on-boarding of all aspects of facility
Responsible for providing accurate cost and revenue accruals on a monthly basis
Manage DSO of projects to ensure compliance with contract terms
Manage project costs and approvals of AP invoices to ensure proper cost coding and verification of expenditure
Manage owner invoicing process to ensure all invoices are submitted accurately and in a timely manner, prior to deadlines
Maintain timely and accurate reporting to management on all pertinent issues
Manage, train, and supervise project team according to Company policy
Review contract conditions; ensure compliance with all contract terms
Supervise documentation of all significant project events, e.g., accidents, Change Orders
Supervise the negotiation, preparation and issuance of subcontract bid packages
Maintain quality control (integrity and excellence of completed project)
Analyze best practices in industry for system operations.
Ensure full compliance of services obligations.
Ensures that all contractual obligations for power plants including laws, ordinances and contracts (i.e. PPA , LGIA land leases) are met.
Drives continuous improvements and best practices in O&M
Interface regularly with project owner and others to deliver enhanced customer satisfaction, communication and reporting.
Work closely with outside resources to resolve long term systemic plant performance issues to provide root cause analyses
Prioritization of day-to-day Service teams’ departmental tasks, delegate and accomplish goals through collaboration with strong leadership and management experience.
Fulfill role as the Project Management team executive for multiple team members and projects across North America.
Providing leadership, guidance and support to both team members, as well as members of the extended team
Contribute as thought leader for business and resource planning, charting and initiating challenging project strategies, and developing new processes.
Proactively manage and identify project risks through problem solving.
Coordinate with other internal Directors across various project disciplines to lead the organization into the future.
Play a key strategic role in portfolio planning, valuation, transaction and construction of new projects.
Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned.
Complete other responsibilities as assigned

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

High School Diploma or equivalent
Degree in Business Management preferred
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills to work with others under all situations
Ability to work collaboratively within a project team, as well as to analyze, troubleshoot and prioritize problems independently
Strong analytical and quantitative skills
Demonstrate computer knowledge (Microsoft Office / monitoring software) with data analysis, modeling and reporting background in Excel and applicable databases
Proficiency and knowledgeable of office practices, procedures, and equipment
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize and coordinate independently
Superior time management skills with an emphasis in task prioritization

Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions:

Ability to work in a high pace, high stress environment
Ability to tolerate heavy call/meeting days
Requires frequent stooping, bending, crouching, reaching, handling, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting 20 or more lbs
Constant ability to see details at close range and at a distance, hear, talk, and possess depth perception
Extended periods of time sitting in front of computer using finger dexterity, and near and far vision
Occasional climbing and carrying, proximity to moving mechanical parts, working in high exposed areas
Occasional exposure to dust and fumes, electric shock, radiation, toxic/caustic chemicals
The noise intensity level is high
Minimal travel will be required

współpraca z zespołami wewnętrznymi, interesariuszami i partnerami zewnętrznymi,

raportowanie postępów i dbanie o sprawną komunikację projektową,

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We’re seeking an experienced Engineering Program Manager to join Cohere’s customer-facing Engineering Program Management team. We need someone with curiosity, drive, independence, and leadership, who has hands-on experience working directly with customers and managing projects for enterprise-grade software or enterprise-focused machine learning solutions. In return, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Cohere’s operations, collaborate with leading minds in the LLM space, work directly with our Strategic Customers as well as Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform , Product and Go-to-Market teams, and be the “technical” voice of Cohere for the customer. You will get a chance to create extremely high-impact contributions to our fast-growing company, product and culture.

As an Engineering Program Manager/ Technical Program Manager, you will:

Communicate: Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across the tech organization, Cohere teams, leadership, and most importantly - our strategic customers and external partners.
Optimize: Break down complex issues into strategies, driving engineering alignment with product, business, and marketing while fostering collaboration.
Plan: Create and manage program/project schedules, identify dependencies, manage risks, and drive organizational alignment.
Execute: Ensure on-time delivery, identify development needs, and establish checkpoints for status updates.
Problem solve: Proactively identify and resolve issues, coordinate cross-functional dependencies, and prioritize impacts to schedule and product quality.

You May Be a Good Fit If

You have at least 5 years of experience as an Engineering or Technical Program Manager, with at least 2 years in customer-facing technical delivery and operations focused on enterprise-grade AI software/solutions
Knowledge or experience with LLM training or optimization would be a key differentiator
You are problem-focused and making customers successful really excites you
You are detail-oriented and extremely self-organized. You love enabling people and teams around you, and are excellent at capturing detailed notes/action items during highly technical meetings and tracking progress.
You have a Bias for Action - you are very execution focused and you like getting things done.
You have experience working with cross-functional teams to get technical products, services or solutions shipped to an internal or an external customer and can independently own tracking and reporting across multiple work-streams, with owners in different time-zones.
You are comfortable holding leaders and individual contributors accountable. You can be assertive while remaining diplomatic. You are not afraid to follow up with people to ensure shipping within committed deadlines.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work

Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. Job Description:

*Please note: This opportunity requires working in US hours*

The Epiq Contracts Solutions practice is looking for an experienced Sr.
Project Manager
to lead CLM implementations, consulting and strategy projects within our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end project management activities for CLM engagements, including current-state assessments, designing future-state processes, vendor selections, and implementations. As a subject matter expert in CLM, you will support all aspects of the implementation lifecycle, ensuring strategic alignment and successful outcomes for our clients. Additionally, you will act as a thought leader in CLM AI (GenAI) to contribute to our service offerings roadmap and the development of the CLM practice.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Management
Lead project management for CLM engagements, from initial scoping and planning through execution and post-implementation review.
Oversee timelines, resource allocation, risk management, and deliverables to ensure project milestones are met.
Serve as the primary client point of contact, managing communications, expectations, and relationship building to foster long-term client partnerships.

Implementation Leadership & CLM Expertise
Serve as the CLM subject matter expert, advising clients on implementation strategy, configuration, testing, and user adoption.
Support functional design workshops, facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT), and manage issue resolution.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure the implementation meets the defined requirements and aligns with best practices.

Current-State Assessment & To-Be Process Design
Conduct comprehensive current-state assessments of clients’ contract management processes, identifying inefficiencies, compliance risks, and areas for improvement.
Develop tailored future-state process designs, mapping to industry best practices and aligning with the client’s strategic objectives.
Define a roadmap for successful implementation, including a clear transition strategy from the current to the desired future state.

CLM Vendor Selection
Lead the vendor selection process by defining requirements, facilitating demos, and evaluating vendors’ fit against client-specific needs.
Develop and deliver selection scorecards, assist in decision analysis, and guide clients in selecting the CLM platform that best meets their functional and technical requirements.

Thought Leadership in CLM AI & GenAI
Contribute to the development of our CLM AI (GenAI) services roadmap, defining strategies for integrating AI to enhance contract automation, compliance, and risk management.
Act as a thought leader within the CLM practice by identifying emerging trends, sharing insights on AI/GenAI in CLM, and contributing to white papers, webinars, and industry events.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine AI-powered offerings that align with the evolving needs of our clients.

Practice Development & Team Mentorship
Support the growth of the CLM practice by contributing to methodology, tools, and frameworks.
Mentor junior consultants, providing guidance and expertise to develop their CLM knowledge and consulting skills.
Engage in continuous learning and stay updated on industry advancements in CLM, AI, and technology trends.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Law, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in CLM consulting, legal operations, or a similar role, with a proven track record in CLM project leadership.
Deep expertise in CLM platforms (e.g., Agiloft, Icertis, Conga, Malbek, ContractPodAi) and contract management processes.

Project Management & Technical Skills
Strong project management skills with experience managing large-scale, complex CLM projects from start to finish.
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and experience with GenAI capabilities within CLM platforms.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) and CLM solutions.

Analytical & Strategic Thinking
Ability to assess and map current processes, identify gaps, and design scalable, future-ready CLM solutions.
Analytical mindset with a knack for translating strategic goals into tactical project plans.

Communication & Leadership Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong leadership and client relationship management skills, with a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. Understanding of NEC contracts or similar, with experience in contract administration and compliance. 

Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders. 

Competency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project) and a proactive approach to process improvement.

Work-life balance

You will be joining a collaborative team that combines technical expertise, strong client relationships and a practical approach to delivering high-quality built environment projects.

What you need to do to be effective in this role

Managing the day-to-day delivery of construction projects from inception through to completion
Building trusted relationships with clients, consultants, contractors and wider project stakeholders
Supporting the delivery of historic building, cladding remediation, education and wider public and private sector projects
Developing clear project documentation, programmes, reports, risk registers and decision records
Attending, chairing and recording meetings, ensuring actions are captured and progressed
Producing concise and professional reports to suit the relevant stage of each project.

In addition to the above you will also be responsible for the following key activities:

Identifying and developing innovative, practical solutions for clients across complex and live environments
Assisting with leading and managing multidisciplinary design teams
Supporting feasibility studies, site surveys, investigations and project option appraisals
Monitoring and reporting on contractor progress, quality, risk and programme performance on site
Contributing to projects that protect and enhance existing buildings, improve safety and compliance, and support the delivery of modern learning environments
Supporting the Reading team in developing new business opportunities and strengthening existing client relationships
Developing the skills to act as a single point of contact, taking responsibility for project delivery and client liaison.

The skills and experience you need to have for this role

Construction project management experience is essential
Experience of working on building projects, ideally including refurbishment, education, heritage, remediation or occupied-site environments
Experience using Microsoft Office software and Microsoft Project
A degree in a construction-related subject is desirable, but not essential. All relevant degree backgrounds will be considered
Experience of delivering presentations and communicating clearly with clients and senior professionals
Excellent written communication skills, with experience in report writing, meeting notes and project documentation.

Qualifications

Diploma, BSc or MSc in project management, construction management, building surveying or another relevant built environment discipline
You will ideally be working towards, or considering working towards, one of the professional qualifications below:
MRICS
MCIOB

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Negotiate cost-effective subcontract and material purchases.
Manage subcontractors and vendors to ensure their compliance with contract terms, scope of work, and schedule.
Develop and maintain good relationship with Owners, subcontractors and SOLV team.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager (Datacentre Delivery)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate. Leads technical program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes. Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within technical programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving technical discussions that align priorities and program goals. Provides technical expertise, direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams. Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage technical program execution. Acts as a technical liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.

– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.

– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.

– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.

– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.

– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.

– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.

– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.

– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.

– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage program execution.

– Utilizes data to solve moderately complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a small number of data sources with moderate complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Acts as a liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

– Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align program priorities and commitments.

– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.

– Identifies risks to customer satisfaction and advocates for improvements or mitigation.

– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team and related teams to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.

– Helps balance team priorities and Oracle commitments to ensure optimal coverage and response to key customer needs, minimizing risks to the program.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

– Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

– Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

– Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

– Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

– Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

– Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Qualifications

Minimum Job Qualifications

Education and/or Experience:

11 years of experience as a Program Manager leading large technical programs or projects, development/implementation projects or experience managing complex cross-functional programs, from conception to delivery

OR

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Software Development, Electrical/Hardware Engineering, or related field AND 7 years of experience as a Program Manager leading large technical programs or projects, development/implementation projects or experience managing complex cross-functional programs, from conception to delivery

OR

Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Software Development, Electrical/Hardware Engineering, or related field AND 5 years of experience as a Program Manager leading large technical programs or projects, development/implementation projects or experience managing complex cross-functional programs, from conception to delivery

OR

Doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Software Development, Electrical/Hardware Engineering, or related field AND 3 year of experience as a Program Manager le

jobs.title: AI Legal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
The Role
As AI Legal Program Manager, you will play a key role in navigating the legal and regulatory landscape of Block's artificial intelligence initiatives. You will partner with legal, engineering, product, and compliance teams to develop frameworks that enable responsible AI innovation while ensuring regulatory compliance and risk management across our AI products and services.
You will:
Drive the development and implementation of AI legal and compliance frameworks, including policies for model development, deployment, and monitoring that align with emerging AI regulations and industry standards.
Participate in cross-functional reviews of AI project initiatives to identify legal risks and opportunities, ensuring compliance with regulations while enabling innovation.
Develop and maintain AI governance documentation, including model cards, algorithmic impact assessments, training data compliance records, and legal risk assessments.
Partner with engineering teams to implement legally compliant AI development practices, including requirements for transparency, fairness, and accountability.
Create and maintain processes for AI incident response, model monitoring, and legal compliance validation.
Build scalable processes for AI legal reviews across various stakeholders.

You have:
5+ years of directly related experience in technical program management, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML initiatives in a technology-driven environment.
Strong understanding of emerging AI regulations (EU AI Act, state AI laws, etc.) and their practical implementation.
Experience developing legal frameworks for AI governance and responsible AI development.
Track record of partnering with technical teams to implement legal requirements in AI systems.
Understanding of IP considerations in AI development, including training data rights, model ownership, and output licensing.
Experience with AI risk assessment methodologies and mitigation strategies.
Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

Even better:
Experience with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI legal considerations
Background in open source software licensing and AI model licensing
Familiarity with AI ethics frameworks and algorithmic fairness principles
Experience with AI procurement and vendor assessment
Knowledge of global AI regulatory developments and policy trends
Background in privacy law and data protection regulations
Technical background or demonstrated ability to understand AI/ML concept

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is a proud equal opportunity employer. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to identity or other legally protected class. 

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible.  Want to learn more about what we’re doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Check out our
 I+D page
.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.
Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 
Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.
Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Monitoring and Observability
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE:
Program Manager, Monitoring and Observability

CLEARANCE REQUIRED:
Public Trust

CLIENT CONTEXT:
Large Federal Agency, billable client-embedded role

LOCATION:
Remote

ABOUT US:

Intact Technology is a ServiceNow Elite Partner focused exclusively on federal and public sector clients. We deliver ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, and AI-enabled workflows that help agencies run smarter. Our delivery model is built on disciplined execution, deep platform knowledge, and outcomes that are measurable.

We are a small, high-performing team. Everyone here owns real work and real results. If you want to be close to the delivery and have direct access to leadership, this is the right place.

THE ROLE:

Intact Technology is a ServiceNow Elite Partner delivering ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, and AI-enabled solutions exclusively to federal and public sector clients. This is a billable, client-embedded position. You will be on-site as Intact's primary delivery lead, not in a support capacity.

You will own the full delivery lifecycle of the monitoring and observability service for a large federal agency, including large scale implementations and migrations supporting platforms ranging from AppDynamics, Splunk, Datadog, Open Text, ServiceNow, etc. That means managing scope, schedule, stakeholders, and quality of delivery from kickoff through O&M transition. Day to day, you operate as part of the client's program team while staying connected to Intact's delivery team driving the program standards.

The client expects a trusted partner who understands their strategy and does not need direction to lead. Intact expects someone who represents our delivery standards in every client interaction. Being effective in both directions at the same time is the job.

This is a high-visibility engagement. The client is experienced, the work is mission-sensitive, and the expectations are high. If disciplined delivery in a complex federal environment is where you do your best work, we want to talk.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL HERE:

You are comfortable being the only Intact person in the room most days. You represent the firm without being prompted. You know how to build a strong client relationship while also protecting Intact's interests, and you understand those two things work together when you are doing the job well.

You do your best work when things are complicated. You do not need perfect information to move forward, but you do need a plan. You hold vendors, teammates, and clients to the same standard and communicate clearly when something is off track. You treat ambiguity as a problem to solve, not something to sit with.

You have worked in federal environments long enough to know that process matters. You also know when process is getting in the way of outcomes, and you are willing to push back constructively and keep things moving.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

Program delivery

Serve as Intact's primary delivery presence on-site, owning the client relationship, program outcomes, and day-to-day execution.
Lead end-to-end delivery across AppDynamics, Splunk, and Datadog workstreams, managing scope, schedule, budget, and risk in parallel.
Own and maintain the program team structure, integrated program plan, keeping workstreams, subcontractors, vendors and client stakeholders aligned.
Support and enforce delivery standards, status cadences, risk registers, and change control processes.
Establish JIRA based delivery framework within a federal program structure, balancing the team's need for agility with the client's governance requirements.

Stakeholder management

Serve as the primary point of contact for the client's program leadership and technical teams. You are the face of Intact on this engagement.
Responsible for advising, consulting, in devising approaches how to achieve strategic goals and desired business outcomes.
Produce executive-ready reporting on a consistent cadence, including weekly status updates for CIO, monthly steering committee materials, and escalations as needed.
Maintain a parallel reporting cadence to Intact leadership covering financials, utilization, risk, and relationship health.
Manage competing priorities across multiple federal stakeholder groups and build trust at every level.

Platform coordination

Coordinate delivery teams across the monitoring platform suite without needing to be the technical expert on each.
Work closely with architects and lead engineers to surface dependencies, remove blockers, and keep delivery on track.
Ensure all platform work connects to the client's broader Enterprise Observability strategy, including ServiceNow integration points.

Continuous improvement

Run structured retrospectives and turn what you learn into repeatable process improvements.
Identify scope growth, change order opportunities, and delivery risks early and communicate them to Intact leadership without delay.
Contribute to Intact's internal delivery frameworks and monitoring practice playbooks.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Department:
Development
Location:
Melville, NY
Compensation:
$135,000 - $140,000 / year

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

1. Drive the day-to-day technical delivery of the Core Wallet and Core Banking Transformation program across one or more workstreams (Technical Build & Integration, Data Migration, Distribution, Operations, or others as assigned), under the direction of the Programme Director.
2. Own the integrated technical plan, dependencies, RAID, ceremonies, and reporting for assigned workstreams — translating the Programme Director's roadmap into executable sprints, milestones, and deliverables.
3. Coordinate Core Platform Supplier, third-party vendors, D&F Tech, and OPCO technology teams on a daily basis to unblock issues, manage dependencies, and keep the program on plan, on budget, and on quality.
4. Provide the Programme Director with clear, structured, evidence-based reporting on progress, risks, issues, and decisions required — and surface escalations early enough to be acted on.

MAIN FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES

Technical planning & execution

• Build and maintain the detailed technical project plan for assigned workstreams; integrate it into the overall program plan owned by the Programme Director.
• Decompose the Programme Director's roadmap into sprints, milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria with clear owners and dates.
• Track progress against plan; spot slippage early; replan proactively with the Programme Director when needed.
• Run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, and other delivery ceremonies for assigned squads.
• Maintain a single, accurate, up-to-date view of status, scope, schedule, and budget.

Dependency, RAID & change management

• Identify, document, and actively manage dependencies within the workstream and across other workstreams (Product, Compliance, Data, Distribution, Operations, Customer Care).
• Maintain Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAID) logs; drive mitigation actions to closure.
• Run change control for the workstream — assess impact (scope, time, cost, quality), recommend decisions, and route through program governance.
• Escalate blockers and material risks to the Programme Director with clear options and recommendations, not just problems.

Vendor & cross-team coordination

• Coordinate Core Wallet delivery teams and third-party vendors on a daily basis — track SOW deliverables, milestones, and SLA adherence.
• Align D&F Tech, Architecture, Security, OPCO technology, and BU teams on shared deliverables and integration points.
• Chair working groups; ensure decisions are documented, owners assigned, and follow-through happens.
• Hold vendors and internal teams accountable to commitments without losing the working relationship.

Testing, quality & technical readiness

• Plan and orchestrate SIT, UAT, performance, and security testing cycles in coordination with QA, vendors, and BU teams.
• Track defects, drive triage, prioritization, and closure against agreed quality gates.
• Ensure environments, test data, and access are in place ahead of each test cycle.
• Validate technical readiness for go-live: cutover plans, rollback plans, runbooks, monitoring, and on-call coverage.
• Coordinate dry runs and rehearsals; chase down every open item before cutover.

Governance, reporting & documentation

• Produce weekly / fortnightly workstream status reports for the Programme Director and program governance forums.
• Maintain accurate project artefacts: plans, RAID logs, decision logs, action logs, meeting minutes, and change records.
• Contribute to Steering Committee packs with clear data, options, and recommendations.
• Ensure traceability between requirements, designs, build, test results, and deployment.

Budget, resource & operational discipline

• Track workstream budget consumption against forecast; flag variances early.
• Manage resource onboarding, allocation, and offboarding across the workstream — internal staff, contractors, and vendor resources.
• Drive operational discipline in tooling: JIRA hygiene, Confluence documentation, SharePoint structure, and reporting cadence.
• Capture lessons learned at each phase and feed them into subsequent OPCO rollouts.

LEVEL OF EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications or equivalent. PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master (CSM / PSM), or SAFe certifications are strongly preferred.

LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE:

Minimum 10 years of project / delivery management experience in technology, with at least 3 years in fintech, mobile money, digital banking, or telecom.
Hands-on technical delivery experience on core wallet, core banking, or payments platforms
Proven track record running technical workstreams within larger transformation programs, including integration delivery and data migration.
Experience managing tier-1 vendor delivery teams alongside third-party integrators.
Experience in African markets is preferred; experience in multi-country delivery is an advantage.
Strong working knowledge of Agile (Scrum / Kanban), Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models; comfortable picking the right approach for the context.

INTERPERSONAL SKILLS REQUIRED:

Highly organized; relentless on follow-through and closure.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to produce crisp, executive-ready status reports.
Comfortable holding engineers, architects, and vendors to account without damaging working relationships.
Pragmatic problem-solver; reaches for the simplest solution that works.
Calm under pressure during cutovers, incidents, and escalations.
Comfortable working with diverse, multicultural, multilingual teams across Africa.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sufficient technical literacy to read architecture and integration designs, challenge estimates, and understand the technical trade-offs being made.
Strong command of project management tooling (JIRA, Confluence, MS Project / Smartsheet) and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI).
Working knowledge of the pan-African fintech / mobile money ecosystem (regulation, MNO partnerships, agent economics) is a plus.
High availability and geographical mobility — periodic travel across AFS OPCOs is expected, particularly around go-live windows.

English required; French is a strong advantage given AFS footprint.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking an experienced and mission-focused Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the day-to-day execution and delivery of our next-generation Data Lakehouse platform—a system that empowers Department of War (DoW) cyber operators with unparalleled data access and analytical capabilities at massive scale.

In this role, you are the connective tissue across our Application, Data, and Infrastructure engineering teams, responsible for turning a prioritized roadmap into shipped, deployed, and accredited software on a predictable cadence. You will own the release train end to end—managing cross-team dependencies, schedules, risk, and communication—so that complex, interdependent components come together into a cohesive product our nation's cyber defenders can depend on. You are the single-threaded owner for platform delivery—leading through influence, earning trust across teams you do not directly manage, and freeing engineering and QA leadership to stay focused on architecture, quality, and the platform's future direction.

You will partner closely with Product Owners, engineering leads, QA, and operations, and communicate release contents and delivery timelines directly to government stakeholders. Product vision, roadmap, and prioritization remain with Product Owners and engineering leadership; you own the execution machinery—backlog to build to release—that turns those priorities into shipped, validated software. Work is performed in a hybrid environment with some onsite work 1-2 days a week in Columbia, MD, with occasional travel (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.

#Executive

Essential Job Responsibilities

Program Execution: Drive the platform delivery cadence—monthly sprints and quarterly releases—across all engineering teams. Translate the roadmap into milestone-driven delivery plans.
Roadmap Operationalization: Partner with Product Owners to convert roadmap priorities into sprint-ready backlog items with clear acceptance criteria. Manage intake mechanics and track feature validation.
Release Management: Orchestrate the end-to-end release process from code-complete to deployment. Coordinate with QA/Release engineering to drive integration testing and go/no-go readiness decisions.
Cross-Team Dependencies: Map and sequence interdependencies between engineering teams. Actively unblock components to ensure clean integration and minimize schedule slips.
Risk & Blocker Mitigation: Maintain a risk register for schedule, technical, and security risks. Surface issues early and drive path-to-resolution escalations.
Financial Monitoring: Track program budget, burn rates, and forecasts. Ensure financial and schedule risks are managed as a single picture.
Security Authorization: Shepherd artifacts through customer security scanning and authorization (RMF/ATO) to keep accreditation off the critical path.
Program Communication: Establish reporting mechanisms, release notes, and sync cadences to keep engineering and government stakeholders aligned.
Technical Deep-Dive: Understand platform architecture (Lakehouse, Kubernetes, IAM) to facilitate technical tradeoff discussions and assess integration risks.
Stakeholder Representation: Act as the platform's voice to cyber stakeholders via release announcements and live demos. Ensure successful deployment across operating environments.
Business Development Support: Contribute delivery plans and technical inputs to proposals. Deliver platform demonstrations that resonate with DoW requirements.
Operational Excellence: Own triage for support and community requests. Partner with Product Owners to turn feedback into prioritized work while improving release processes.
Metrics & Improvement: Define and track metrics for predictability, cycle time, and defect rates to drive continuous delivery improvements.
Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Clearance Requirement: Must obtain and maintain a Secret level U.S. Government Security Clearance, but not required on day one; U.S. Citizenship required.
6+ years in DoW cyber, agile software development, and/or big data with a B.A. in Business, a technical field, or related; 4 years relevant experience with a Master's in a related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in a Technical Program Manager, Program Manager, Delivery Lead, or equivalent role responsible for driving software delivery within an Agile development environment.

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority—setting direction, forcing decisions, and holding teams accountable without direct reporting lines.
Demonstrated understanding of modern data architectures, including concepts like data lakes, data lakehouses, data warehousing, and big data technologies.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a talent for making complex technical subjects accessible to varied audiences and for driving clarity across teams.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many moving parts simultaneously.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability and willingness to travel occasionally (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.
Ability to work on site 1-2 days a week in Columbia, MD. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed.

Preferred Requirements

Current Clearances: Active Secret or Top Secret clearances are a strong plus.

Program/project management or agile certifications.
Professional experience within or adjacent to the cybersecurity domain (e.g., Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Network Defense, Incident Response).
