Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

As a member of the KWI team you will receive

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Our commitment to you

At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

With a commitment to maintaining a bias-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. We expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.

new_jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

1. Drive the day-to-day technical delivery of the Core Wallet and Core Banking Transformation program across one or more workstreams (Technical Build & Integration, Data Migration, Distribution, Operations, or others as assigned), under the direction of the Programme Director.
2. Own the integrated technical plan, dependencies, RAID, ceremonies, and reporting for assigned workstreams — translating the Programme Director's roadmap into executable sprints, milestones, and deliverables.
3. Coordinate Core Platform Supplier, third-party vendors, D&F Tech, and OPCO technology teams on a daily basis to unblock issues, manage dependencies, and keep the program on plan, on budget, and on quality.
4. Provide the Programme Director with clear, structured, evidence-based reporting on progress, risks, issues, and decisions required — and surface escalations early enough to be acted on.

MAIN FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES

Technical planning & execution

• Build and maintain the detailed technical project plan for assigned workstreams; integrate it into the overall program plan owned by the Programme Director.
• Decompose the Programme Director's roadmap into sprints, milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria with clear owners and dates.
• Track progress against plan; spot slippage early; replan proactively with the Programme Director when needed.
• Run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, and other delivery ceremonies for assigned squads.
• Maintain a single, accurate, up-to-date view of status, scope, schedule, and budget.

Dependency, RAID & change management

• Identify, document, and actively manage dependencies within the workstream and across other workstreams (Product, Compliance, Data, Distribution, Operations, Customer Care).
• Maintain Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAID) logs; drive mitigation actions to closure.
• Run change control for the workstream — assess impact (scope, time, cost, quality), recommend decisions, and route through program governance.
• Escalate blockers and material risks to the Programme Director with clear options and recommendations, not just problems.

Vendor & cross-team coordination

• Coordinate Core Wallet delivery teams and third-party vendors on a daily basis — track SOW deliverables, milestones, and SLA adherence.
• Align D&F Tech, Architecture, Security, OPCO technology, and BU teams on shared deliverables and integration points.
• Chair working groups; ensure decisions are documented, owners assigned, and follow-through happens.
• Hold vendors and internal teams accountable to commitments without losing the working relationship.

Testing, quality & technical readiness

• Plan and orchestrate SIT, UAT, performance, and security testing cycles in coordination with QA, vendors, and BU teams.
• Track defects, drive triage, prioritization, and closure against agreed quality gates.
• Ensure environments, test data, and access are in place ahead of each test cycle.
• Validate technical readiness for go-live: cutover plans, rollback plans, runbooks, monitoring, and on-call coverage.
• Coordinate dry runs and rehearsals; chase down every open item before cutover.

Governance, reporting & documentation

• Produce weekly / fortnightly workstream status reports for the Programme Director and program governance forums.
• Maintain accurate project artefacts: plans, RAID logs, decision logs, action logs, meeting minutes, and change records.
• Contribute to Steering Committee packs with clear data, options, and recommendations.
• Ensure traceability between requirements, designs, build, test results, and deployment.

Budget, resource & operational discipline

• Track workstream budget consumption against forecast; flag variances early.
• Manage resource onboarding, allocation, and offboarding across the workstream — internal staff, contractors, and vendor resources.
• Drive operational discipline in tooling: JIRA hygiene, Confluence documentation, SharePoint structure, and reporting cadence.
• Capture lessons learned at each phase and feed them into subsequent OPCO rollouts.

LEVEL OF EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications or equivalent. PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master (CSM / PSM), or SAFe certifications are strongly preferred.

LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE:

Minimum 10 years of project / delivery management experience in technology, with at least 3 years in fintech, mobile money, digital banking, or telecom.
Hands-on technical delivery experience on core wallet, core banking, or payments platforms
Proven track record running technical workstreams within larger transformation programs, including integration delivery and data migration.
Experience managing tier-1 vendor delivery teams alongside third-party integrators.
Experience in African markets is preferred; experience in multi-country delivery is an advantage.
Strong working knowledge of Agile (Scrum / Kanban), Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models; comfortable picking the right approach for the context.

INTERPERSONAL SKILLS REQUIRED:

Highly organized; relentless on follow-through and closure.
Strong written and verbal communication; able to produce crisp, executive-ready status reports.
Comfortable holding engineers, architects, and vendors to account without damaging working relationships.
Pragmatic problem-solver; reaches for the simplest solution that works.
Calm under pressure during cutovers, incidents, and escalations.
Comfortable working with diverse, multicultural, multilingual teams across Africa.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sufficient technical literacy to read architecture and integration designs, challenge estimates, and understand the technical trade-offs being made.
Strong command of project management tooling (JIRA, Confluence, MS Project / Smartsheet) and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI).
Working knowledge of the pan-African fintech / mobile money ecosystem (regulation, MNO partnerships, agent economics) is a plus.
High availability and geographical mobility — periodic travel across AFS OPCOs is expected, particularly around go-live windows.

English required; French is a strong advantage given AFS footprint.

Benefits

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking an experienced and mission-focused Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the day-to-day execution and delivery of our next-generation Data Lakehouse platform—a system that empowers Department of War (DoW) cyber operators with unparalleled data access and analytical capabilities at massive scale.

In this role, you are the connective tissue across our Application, Data, and Infrastructure engineering teams, responsible for turning a prioritized roadmap into shipped, deployed, and accredited software on a predictable cadence. You will own the release train end to end—managing cross-team dependencies, schedules, risk, and communication—so that complex, interdependent components come together into a cohesive product our nation's cyber defenders can depend on. You are the single-threaded owner for platform delivery—leading through influence, earning trust across teams you do not directly manage, and freeing engineering and QA leadership to stay focused on architecture, quality, and the platform's future direction.

You will partner closely with Product Owners, engineering leads, QA, and operations, and communicate release contents and delivery timelines directly to government stakeholders. Product vision, roadmap, and prioritization remain with Product Owners and engineering leadership; you own the execution machinery—backlog to build to release—that turns those priorities into shipped, validated software. Work is performed in a hybrid environment with some onsite work 1-2 days a week in Columbia, MD, with occasional travel (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.

#Executive

Essential Job Responsibilities

Program Execution: Drive the platform delivery cadence—monthly sprints and quarterly releases—across all engineering teams. Translate the roadmap into milestone-driven delivery plans.
Roadmap Operationalization: Partner with Product Owners to convert roadmap priorities into sprint-ready backlog items with clear acceptance criteria. Manage intake mechanics and track feature validation.
Release Management: Orchestrate the end-to-end release process from code-complete to deployment. Coordinate with QA/Release engineering to drive integration testing and go/no-go readiness decisions.
Cross-Team Dependencies: Map and sequence interdependencies between engineering teams. Actively unblock components to ensure clean integration and minimize schedule slips.
Risk & Blocker Mitigation: Maintain a risk register for schedule, technical, and security risks. Surface issues early and drive path-to-resolution escalations.
Financial Monitoring: Track program budget, burn rates, and forecasts. Ensure financial and schedule risks are managed as a single picture.
Security Authorization: Shepherd artifacts through customer security scanning and authorization (RMF/ATO) to keep accreditation off the critical path.
Program Communication: Establish reporting mechanisms, release notes, and sync cadences to keep engineering and government stakeholders aligned.
Technical Deep-Dive: Understand platform architecture (Lakehouse, Kubernetes, IAM) to facilitate technical tradeoff discussions and assess integration risks.
Stakeholder Representation: Act as the platform's voice to cyber stakeholders via release announcements and live demos. Ensure successful deployment across operating environments.
Business Development Support: Contribute delivery plans and technical inputs to proposals. Deliver platform demonstrations that resonate with DoW requirements.
Operational Excellence: Own triage for support and community requests. Partner with Product Owners to turn feedback into prioritized work while improving release processes.
Metrics & Improvement: Define and track metrics for predictability, cycle time, and defect rates to drive continuous delivery improvements.
Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Clearance Requirement: Must obtain and maintain a Secret level U.S. Government Security Clearance, but not required on day one; U.S. Citizenship required.
6+ years in DoW cyber, agile software development, and/or big data with a B.A. in Business, a technical field, or related; 4 years relevant experience with a Master's in a related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in a Technical Program Manager, Program Manager, Delivery Lead, or equivalent role responsible for driving software delivery within an Agile development environment.

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority—setting direction, forcing decisions, and holding teams accountable without direct reporting lines.
Demonstrated understanding of modern data architectures, including concepts like data lakes, data lakehouses, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
Proven ability to work effectively with DoW or other Federal Government customers, with an understanding of their operational environment, procurement, and accreditation processes.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a talent for making complex technical subjects accessible to varied audiences and for driving clarity across teams.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many moving parts simultaneously.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability and willingness to travel occasionally (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.

new_jobs.title: Technology Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Technology Program Manager

6-12 month contract with strong potential for extension and/or hire
Hybrid based in St. Louis, MO

About the Role

We are seeking a Technology Program Manager to help coordinate delivery across a growing Business Technology organization. This role will provide structure, visibility, and governance across multiple technology initiatives and teams, ensuring dependencies, risks, priorities, and delivery timelines are effectively managed.

Reporting to a Director of Technology Delivery, the Technology Program Manager will serve as a key connector across technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working in a matrixed environment, and able to translate complex delivery information into clear, actionable business updates.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Team Delivery Coordination
Track dependencies, risks, issues, and blockers across multiple technology initiatives and workstreams.
Maintain a portfolio-level roadmap and identify sequencing conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delivery impacts.
Facilitate coordination across teams when initiatives have shared dependencies or competing priorities.
Escalate significant delivery risks and blockers to appropriate technology and business leadership.

Delivery Governance & Reporting
Track key delivery metrics and provide visibility into project and program health.
Maintain appropriate documentation, decision records, approvals, and delivery artifacts.
Establish consistent reporting practices across teams and initiatives.
Help ensure technology delivery processes and governance standards are followed consistently.

Executive & Stakeholder Visibility
Build and maintain dashboards, status reports, and other portfolio-level reporting.
Prepare materials and updates for leadership meetings and strategic reviews.
Translate technical delivery information into clear, concise, business-focused communications.
Provide leadership with visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and upcoming priorities.

Process & Practice Improvement
Partner with Product Owners, Technical Analysts, Project Managers, and technical leads to improve delivery processes.
Help establish and refine templates, workflows, prioritization practices, and delivery ceremonies.
Identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and transparency across technology initiatives.
Support the continued development and maturity of the organization's technology delivery practice.

Qualifications

Required
4+ years of experience in technology project or program management.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, workstreams, or initiatives.
Strong understanding of traditional delivery metrics, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies.
Familiarity with software and technology delivery metrics such as cycle time, deployment frequency, quality, and defect rates.
Experience establishing or maintaining cross-team dependency, risk, and issue management processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred
Experience working with AI-assisted, automation, or emerging technology delivery practices.
Interest in understanding how AI and automation may impact technology delivery, governance, risk, and quality.
Experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing, field services, or another project-driven industry.
Experience with project or portfolio management tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
Experience supporting technology transformation, digital modernization, or enterprise technology initiatives.

What Success Looks Like:
First 90 Days

Establish strong visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, and delivery priorities.
Contribute to a consistent portfolio-level reporting cadence.
Build effective relationships with technology leaders, delivery teams, and business stakeholders.

Within 6 Months

Portfolio reporting provides clear visibility into the status and health of key initiatives.
Risks, dependencies, and delivery concerns are identified and escalated proactively.
Teams are consistently using established delivery processes and reporting standards.

Within 12 Months

Cross-team planning and sequencing becomes increasingly proactive and coordinated.
Leadership has a reliable source of truth for technology portfolio status, risks, and priorities.
The Technology Program Manager is recognized as a key connector across technology teams and business stakeholders.

Ongoing

Help strengthen the organization's technology delivery practice through effective governance, communication, process improvement, and portfolio visibility.

Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Microsoft’s cloud infrastructure, spanning site selection, development, and operations. Our global footprint includes more than 400 datacenters in 34 countries, supported by over 165,000 miles of fiber optic cable. These facilities form the backbone of Microsoft Azure and are central to our commitment to reliable, secure, and sustainable digital infrastructure.

As part of the CO+I Energy Team, you will join a team of professionals responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and delivering strategic energy projects. The candidate will manage a portfolio of activities to identify and execute energy opportunities to advance Microsoft’s datacenter growth, in line with strategies to leverage sustainability, time to market and economic value in order to solidify Microsoft’s leadership in providing infrastructure for the global AI economy.

As a Sr. Energy Markets Program Manager, Strategic Projects you will manage activities to execute power interconnection and energy supply agreements for Microsoft’s data centers. This role will specifically lead our special strategic data center portfolio needs with partners that have enabled behind-the-meter energy infrastructure delivery programs. You will also manage and lead the evaluation of energy markets especially in the State of Texas, electric power rates, and tariffs in ERCOT and related utilities that are critical to power delivery and sustainability in that market. In this role, you will manage, build and lead relationships with utilities, strategic energy partners and other stakeholders to execute strategic energy supply opportunities.

A successful candidate will thrive working cross functionally with other business stakeholders that are essential to successful project execution. This includes helping develop and provide financial analytics to support business reviews and recommendations on cost effective power agreements to CO+I leadership. This role will support our Data Center Energy Markets teams principally in the Americas (Canada, the United States, and LATAM).

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Manage and lead datacenter interconnection, behind-the-meter arrangements and energy supply contract development with utilities and third-party energy suppliers in support of Microsoft’s datacenter businesses in the State of Texas and ERCOT.
Manage and lead in the analysis of energy industry trends, market policy and regulations to proactively identify opportunities to reduce cost, minimize risk, and advance sustainability goals.
Manage strategy development and execution of regulatory engagements for behind-the-meter power infrastructure needs with utilities, regulators, and related stakeholders important to datacenter infrastructure deliver, cost/range management and sustainability goals.
Work collaboratively with external vendors and consultants on regional market research.

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position Summary

Nava is seeking a Senior Program Manager (ISSO) to lead system security, risk management, and infrastructure oversight in support of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

In this role, you'll lead Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, maintain the system's Authorization to Operate (ATO), oversee security controls and risk assessments, support continuous monitoring and incident response, and serve as a trusted advisor to CMS stakeholders on the program's overall security and privacy posture.

The ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree and at least seven years of relevant experience, with a strong background in the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authorization to Operate (ATO) management, cybersecurity, and federal compliance. Experience leading security assessments, managing POA&Ms, and implementing federal security controls in an operational environment is essential. While Nava and CMS provide onboarding through the ISSO Handbook and ISSO Boot Camp, candidates should bring established experience managing RMF activities and supporting federal information security programs. Although no specific certification is required under the contract, credentials such as CISSP, CISM, or CompTIA Security+ are highly desirable.

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role supporting one of CMS's mission-critical systems. You'll work closely with engineering teams, program leadership, and federal stakeholders to strengthen the program's security posture while helping deliver secure, reliable digital services that support millions of Americans.

What you'll do

Serve as an ISSO supporting the implementation and ongoing maintenance of information security controls for assigned OEDA systems
Provide security engineering support for information systems and services operating within CMS-authorized enterprise platforms, including cloud-based and managed service environments
Provide essential support to the Authorizing Official (AO) and Authorizing Official Designated Representative (AODR) in making risk-based authorization decisions
Conduct continuous monitoring activities for assigned systems, including security event logging, vulnerability scanning, and configuration management to ensure ongoing compliance with security requirements and ATO conditions
Serve as the principal advisor to the Program ISSO involving the security and privacy of an information system
Be responsible for ensuring the implementation and maintenance of security and privacy controls in accordance with existing agency
Department, and federal government policies, as applicable
Provide guidance, oversight, and expertise to the development of security documents and implementation of security and privacy controls

Required Skills

7+ years cybersecurity experience with a focus on federal contracts
Must have experience with Custom Software or Cloud infrastructure programs/projects
Federal security officer experience required
Experience working with or for government agencies, with solid understanding of government contracting, compliance, and importance of audit trails
Experience with leading and growing agile development teams and the challenges of managing a project at scale, whether you inherited that team or built it from scratch
Ability to demonstrate experience leading large-scale projects with significant complexity, including managing milestones, dependencies, and integrations with significant risk, uncertainty or scale
Experience using agile frameworks like scrum, kanban, or SAFe and familiarity with agile development practices such as continuous integration and continuous delivery
Empathetic communication and relationship building – you take a service-oriented approach to supporting the program team and our clients
Adaptable problem solving and ability to deal with multi-dimensional challenges involving many organizations, processes, cultures, and technologies
Be highly organized and care deeply about building and growing a sustainable, culture-conscious business
Take a strategic approach to delivery planning and contract management over the medium-term and long-term
Take an iterative approach to execution that emphasizes rapid team progress
Ability to maintain broader situational awareness beyond the immediate team
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Desired Skills

Previous experience in managing Paid Family Leave Benefits Programs, either in-house or as a vendor
Experience working closely with or inside state government (or local government of major cities like NYC, LA, Chicago, or Houston)
Proven track record of building and leading high-performing, agile technology teams of 50+ staff
Experience launching new production systems with high public visibility
Experience with long term, complex, and ambiguous IT modernization efforts
Experience with using common project management tools like Jira and Confluence
Track record of introducing and expanding agile transformation and pursuing best practices in project management with clients and stakeholders
Experience managing projects that provide production operations and support alongside ongoing product/feature development

Compensation

$157,500—$177,300 USD

Other Requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States

Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage
— comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs

Insurance coverage
— Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost

Time off
— vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge

Company holidays
— enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO

Annual bonus

Parental leave

Wellness program

Virtual care

401(k) match

Flexible work

Home office setup

Learning opportunities

Referral bonus

Commuter benefits

Supportive culture

Location

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description

Be part of a great team and play a leadership role in our mission to protect our customers' facilities, personnel, and operations! Our leaders are driven by performance excellence, personal integrity, and a commitment to the security mission.

Vaxcom Services LLC (a Parsons company) is looking for a Deputy Security Program Manager to join our team! In this role you will get to provide leadership to the largest armed security officer program in the company supporting several sensitive facilities and their personnel.

What You'll Be Doing

Providing daily guidance, direction, leadership, and mentoring to a large group (100+) of site managers, armed security supervisors, team leads, and line officers assigned to classified, sensitive facilities throughout the greater Washington DC Metropolitan Area (WMA) as well as other domestic U.S. locations.
Working with the Vaxcom Security Training Program Manager to create, review, revise and deliver mandatory training courses in order to keep officers' required certifications current.
Working with Client leadership to address and resolve issues on a daily basis ensuring that Vaxcom leadership is kept aware.
Enforcing Post Orders, Vaxcom/Client rules, and facility regulations in tandem with site leads, supervisors, and team leads.
Assisting Vaxcom leadership in maintaining and enhancing program performance over time.
Acting as a resource to site managers, supervisors and armed security officers in the program helping them to resolve issues and address problems at the lowest level. This will require travel to multiple facilities in the greater WMA and other domestic U.S. locations for limited amounts of time.
Maintaining and building relationships with the Client and other stakeholders.
Demonstrating outstanding communication skills to include verbal, written, and briefing.
Working with your Site Supervisors to ensure all posts and shifts are adequately covered on a 24/7 basis at all locations.
Performing extensive time and attendance certification on a weekly basis.
Assisting with recruitment activities as required.
Participating in Vaxcom corporate leadership activities as required.
Other ad hoc responsibilities as assigned.

What Required Skills You'll Bring

Bachelors Degree and 5+ years of related physical security experience or high school diploma plus 10 years+ of experience in lieu of a degree.
5+ years of leadership/supervisory experience at any level.
Demonstrated excellent verbal, written, briefing, and interpersonal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to resolve issues at the lowest level ensuring all stakeholders are kept apprised.
Demonstrated experience in working with Client leadership and Program Managers on a daily basis to address issues, changes, and modifications that will impact job requirements.
Demonstrated success in providing mentoring/coaching to teammates or subordinates to improve performance and give career guidance.
Ability to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays on an "as needed" basis. This will require travel to greater WMA facilities and to domestic U.S. sites on an as-needed basis.
Flexibility to take on ad hoc responsibilities and prioritize competing assignments/tasks.
Must be willing and able to complete state required certifications using both a handgun and a patrol rifle as needed.
Must possess an active and current TS/SCI with polygraph.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring

5+ years experience working as an armed security officer, preferably at a classified or sensitive facility.
5+ years experience as a manager/supervisor of 10+ people.
2+ years in either law enforcement/Department of Corrections, or the US Military.
Experience working with senior leadership.
Experience in shift staffing/scheduling, time and attendance reporting, metrics gathering and analysis, and other related administrative processes.

Security Clearance Requirement

An active Top Secret SCI w/Polygraph security clearance is required for this position.

The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

A Little More About The Role…

WSP’s Project Security Managers sit within the Security Management function and deliver security assurance to all projects within their respective government sector. This could be Defence, Nuclear, or any other Government departmental area. They are responsible for complete security assurance for all prospects and projects with the aim of protecting our client’s most sensitive assets.

As a Project Security Manager, you will play a key role in providing an excellent security assurance service to our clients while identifying improvements to existing security programmes and processes. The role will manage all aspects of classified project delivery across the domains of Personnel, Physical and Information Security. You will be the focal point for all security assurance activity within your respective sector, providing targeted security direction and guidance as required.

Key responsibilities

Regular liaison with client security and project delivery teams in interpreting, implementing, and monitoring client security requirements as outlined in contractual security schedules or Security Aspects Letters (SALs).
Supporting the security accreditation and certification process for all external compliance requirements associated with your respective sector.
Supporting the development and implementation of governance and processes associated with security assurance for your respective sector.
Planning and delivery of assurance activities as required by contractual obligations, including but not limited to induction briefings, project-specific security briefings, supplier onboarding, and security awareness training.
Measuring and assessing the performance and effectiveness of security controls, identifying and implementing solutions where corrective action and improvements are needed.
Reviewing the competencies of WSP’s supply chain in all security assurance domains: Personnel, Physical and Information.
Collaborating with business areas in the identification, management, and mitigation of risks to WSP and its clients.
Supporting the development and maturity of WSP’s Security Management System.
Supporting investigations for all security incidents, including near misses, reported within your respective sector.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Hold SC clearance or the ability to achieve it.
Experience as a security manager or security controller in a regulated sector (e.g. Defence/Nuclear) is desirable.
Demonstrable knowledge of HMG security documentation (e.g. GovS:007), frameworks, policy and controls is essential.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence peers and seniors on matters concerning project security compliance and assurance.
Knowledge of risk management methodologies and practical experience of application.
Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and deliver to tight timescales.
A highly motivated and driven individual who adopts a flexible and adaptable approach.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can.
Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager Space Systems Engineering | DELFT
new_jobs.description:
About This Position

Contributing to space technology innovations that benefit our planet. Envision it. Become a project manager space systems engineering at TNO in Delft.

Emerging space-related technologies may hold the key to solving many of the societal challenges we face today. Encrypting communications, for example. Exploring the universe. Monitoring greenhouse gases. As a project manager Space Systems Engineering at the Netherlands’ leading research organisation, you can bring about profound change on our planet (and beyond). At TNO, we’re always reaching for the stars, exploring further than what’s considered possible.

Based in Delft, you’ll be part of an organisation that isn’t out to make a profit but instead uses innovation to help mankind take its next giant leap forward, one innovative step at a time. And with this also stimulating the Dutch economy.

See more of the TNO Unit High Tech Industry and the Space Systems EngineeringGroup on the TNO website.

What will be your role?

As a project manager at TNO Delft, you’ll be responsible for ensuring that technology development projects are delivered on time and within budget, meeting the project goals with high quality. This can be space or ground based optical / opto mechatronic systems. You can expect a variety of projects that are on the edge of what’s technically possible today. Best of all, your work will rarely be repetitive. Our projects are always innovative, always technically complicated, always changing and always challenging, with plenty of room for creativity.

You’ll manage multidisciplinary project teams of scientists, developers and engineers as well as stakeholders in complex international coalitions.

Typical customers will include existing partners in the institutional market and, increasingly, commercial businesses who enter the market for ground-based astronomy, satellite communication and earth observation. Partners may include manufacturing companies (involved in the production of instruments), large mission primes (satellite integration) and universities that help TNO to do basic research.

You will work alongside the TNO Space Business Development Team, which is responsible for the commercial acquisition of projects. Proposal writing and travelling internationally are part of your job too. You will enjoy the benefits of hybrid working.

What we expect from you

A proven track record managing complex projects and teams within the space domain or relevant area’s. You have a finely-tuned political antenna and the ability to communicate on a strategic level with challenging partners. Though never rigid, you have strong communication skills and are sharp, structured and pragmatic. You thrive when dealing with projects that have a lot of uncertainties due to the complex scientific problems we tackle at TNO and the unique nature of our work.

Other Knowledge And Skills You Bring To TNO

A higher professional education (HBO/BSc.) or university (WO/MSc.) degree in a technical discipline.
At least 5 years of project management experience in the space domain or other relevant areas.
Experience in working with different type of stakeholders such as space agencies (ESA, NASA) and (international) organizations.
Affinity with innovation and research.
Ability and interest to develop new ways of working to ensure projects can be executed with short turnaround times.
Excellent written- and oral communication skills.
Working experience with Project Management methodologies (IPMA, PMP, Prince2) is a plus.

What you'll get in return

Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 3762,00 and € 6076,00 (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself.

TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect

An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field.
The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs.
33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis).
An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics.
We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel.
Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly.
Flexible working hours, the possibility to work parttime (32 or 36 hours) and the possibility of working from home.
Extensive relocation package for international candidates.
A good pension scheme.

Benefits

Read more about tailoring your benefits package.

TNO as an employer

Our people are at the heart of TNO. Their curiosity, expertise and entrepreneurial mindset make it possible to deliver high-impact research and innovations that contribute to society’s sustainable wellbeing and prosperity. That is why we invest in an inspiring and inclusive working environment where colleagues can excel, have autonomy and continue to grow.

Your talent and ambition have every opportunity to flourish at TNO. You work with experts (both within and beyond TNO), have access to advanced technology and the freedom to explore, experiment and innovate. Our strength lies in independence, reliability and collaboration. We find each other in wonder and ingenuity. We are driven to push boundaries. By working with businesses and government, and by connecting different perspectives, we strengthen our innovative capability and create responsible, meaningful results.

At TNO, we believe this is our time to help society, government and business move forward faster. Together with driven colleagues, you turn knowledge into concrete innovations or ventures that truly make a difference by combining the power of science and entrepreneurship. And in doing so, you make your mark on our time.

The selection process

Please apply before the 30th of August 2026. The selection process comprises two interview rounds. The preliminary interview takes place in weeksd 37 and 38. The second interview round has been scheduled for weeks 39 and 40 [DAY] of [MONTH], [YEAR]. In a final meeting we will discuss the terms of employment and your tailored benefits package. We aim to finalize the entire process within four weeks.

The selection process may include an online assessment and a reference check.

A certificate of Conduct (VOG) is required before starting a new job at TNO.

As you will be working for clients in the domain of defence and security, a Certificate of No Objection issued by AIVD (the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will have to undergo a security screening. Read more about security screening.

Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

What will your typical day look like?

As a Manager within the Global Sustainability and Infrastructure Program Office, you will lead high-impact initiatives that translate global strategy into execution across the Deloitte network. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will help drive operational rigor, accelerate commercialization, and enable Deloitte’s Sustainability and Infrastructure agenda at scale.

Strategy & Insights Development

Work with leadership, senior business stakeholders, and subject matter specialists to define, shape, and operationalize sustainability & infrastructure go-to-market plays and solutions (a greater emphasis will be on our infrastructure solutions for this role).
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to synthesize industry insights and develop strategic recommendations, ensuring our solutions address core client issues across sectors.

Commercialization & Market Activation

Partner with industry champions and business priority teams to drive commercial activation, including opportunity identification, shaping internal and external GTM narratives, and supporting select campaigns.
Craft clear, compelling narratives and executive-ready presentations to effectively communicate our solutions, value propositions, and market positioning to global leadership and across the firm.

Program Manager

Act as a strategic thought partner to the Global Sustainability & Infrastructure Chief Commercialization Officer, shaping leadership priorities, aligning focus areas, and driving an effective operating cadence (e.g., leadership forums, governance rhythms, and decision-making processes).
Drive enterprise-level visibility and execution rigor across priority initiatives, including tracking decisions, monitoring progress, and ensuring alignment and timely follow-through to support leadership accountability.
Lead the development of executive-ready materials (e.g., PowerPoint presentations, briefing packs, and strategic narratives), translating complex Infrastructure priorities into clear, compelling insights and actionable recommendations for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Act as a bridge between strategy and industry teams, fostering collaboration across member firms, geographies, and sectors to strengthen alignment and impact.
Orchestrate and facilitate live and/or virtual executive meetings, account workshops, and industry planning sessions to deliver tangible outcomes and market traction.

Stakeholder Engagement & Team Leadership

Manage and mentor a diverse team to drive impact on projects, producing high-quality deliverables in a timely and agile manner.
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and quickly get smart on tech solutions as needed to integrate them into our broader strategic and commercialization efforts.

About The Team

The Global Sustainability and Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s strategy, working across industries and businesses to orchestrate and accelerate the commercialization of sustainability and infrastructure services globally.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

5 years of experience in business, with at least one full year at Deloitte, with exposure, experience, and interest in sustainability, infrastructure, and GTM/growth strategy.
Bachelor’s degree – ideally in a business field, with relevant coursework/certifications in topics like environmental sustainability, engineering, finance, etc.
3 years of professional experience with core consulting skills – i.e. analytical, research (primary and secondary), and communication and presentation (logical structuring and storyboarding).
Working experience with AI tools for everyday productivity enhancement; hands-on experience in using advanced PowerPoint and Excel for at least five years.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $156,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

new_jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Powered by technology and compassionate design, Parachute has reimagined the plasma donation experience into one that is easier and friendlier. Using a simple app, our members can book donations and track earnings from the palm of their hand. In using a tech-forward approach, we’re able to offer each member a highly personable and best-in-class experience that’s consistent at each and every visit.
Our vision is to introduce an elevated plasma donation experience to markets with smaller populations that’s grounded in convenience. This model allows us to positively impact the industry supply chain and help patients gain access to the life changing medication they need.
We have grown from 2 to 33+ operations in ~3 years and are looking for new team members to help us scale to 50 centers. We are searching for individuals who share in our passion for helping others and are invigorated by the speed at which our start-up moves. Come join us as we help the world gain access to more plasma - one donation at a time.
What You'll Do

As the Strategy and Operations Manager, you will play a crucial role in driving operational excellence and ensuring quality compliance across multiple facilities. Serving as the primary point of contact between Center Leadership and Corporate departments, you will facilitate seamless communication and alignment between the two.
Oversee a portfolio of centers that generate $15mm - $40mm in annual revenue.
Constantly iterate and re-engineer our existing processes. With our rapid growth we need individuals who can continuously evolve our processes and systems to meet larger needs.
Monitor and assess adherence to quality policies, ensuring facilities maintain compliance with relevant regulations and industry standards.
Analyze performance metrics, KPIs, and nonconformance events to identify areas for center level or corporate level improvement. As an end to end problem solver, you will take issues diagnosis to solution.
Prepare centers for audits and assist the Center Leadership Team (CLT) and corporate departments in audit preparation, inspection and audit response actions representing company to regulatory agencies and inspectors.
Guide and advise on employee-related issues, promoting fairness, and adherence to HR policies while cultivating center leadership through strategic development initiatives.
Ensure facility maintenance meets the highest safety, compliance, and cleanliness standards in partnership with corporate facilities.
Assist with recruitment, training, developing management talent through regular meetings, goal check-ins, development plans and on-site visits and assessments.
Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are able to understand the business from 30,000 feet and know when to nose dive into the weeds to impact outcomes.
Comfortable working with multiple departments in a complex matrixed organization and experience working in a regulated environment.
A data led individual, your first reaction is to delve into the numbers as a source of truth.
Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues and resolve recurring deficiencies.
Strong organizational skills and attention to details to handle multiple tasks, short deadlines, frequent interruptions and shifting priorities in support of changing company objectives.
A natural leader, you have experience and success in managing teams of varying competencies, supporting them to reach progressively larger goals
Comfortable dealing with a degree of ambiguity and proposing pragmatic solutions to problems.
Overnight travel required up to 75% of the time without lengthy lead-time.

Benefits

Career growth opportunities
Competitive compensation
Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
Paid time off
Company paid holidays

new_jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As Global Program Manager for Supplier Quality & Development, you will work directly with the Head of Supplier Quality & Development for Gas Services to turn strategic priorities into coordinated global action.

You will lead complex transformation and improvement programs spanning regions, businesses and functions, bringing together stakeholders who may have different priorities, processes and ways of working. From establishing governance and tracking performance to driving process harmonisation and digitalisation, you will provide the structure and momentum needed to deliver meaningful change across the global Supplier Quality & Development organisation.

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys working across organisational boundaries, influencing without direct authority and taking ownership of strategic programs from concept through to implementation.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead strategic Supplier Quality & Development projects and transformation programs from definition through execution, ensuring initiatives support business growth, operational excellence and wider organisational priorities.
Drive global harmonisation and continuous improvement of supplier quality processes, tools, governance and best practices, creating greater consistency across businesses and regions.
Act as the primary Supplier Quality & Development representative for enterprise and cross-functional programs, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring commitments, dependencies and deliverables remain aligned.
Establish robust program governance, including milestones, performance indicators, executive reporting, risk and issue management, providing leadership with clear visibility of progress and areas requiring intervention.
Champion digitalisation, data analytics and data-driven ways of working to improve transparency, productivity, decision-making and collaboration across the global organisation.
Build strong relationships across Supplier Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and other functions, influencing without direct authority and translating strategic objectives into practical, sustainable improvements.

What You Bring

Proven experience leading complex projects, transformation programs or business improvement initiatives within a large, international industrial or manufacturing organisation.
Strong program and project management capability, including governance, planning, performance tracking, risk management, executive reporting and successful delivery across multiple workstreams.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with demonstrated experience aligning senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams where you do not have direct authority.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability combined with experience driving process improvement, organisational change and operational excellence.
Knowledge of Supplier Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain or Manufacturing processes would be highly advantageous, alongside experience with digitalisation, data analytics and performance reporting.
A structured, proactive and execution-focused approach with excellent communication and organisational skills, plus willingness to travel internationally when required, approximately 20%.

About The Team

Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. We bring together gas turbines, steam turbines, generators and digital service solutions under one roof. Through modernization, digitalization and innovative service offerings, we support customers worldwide in improving reliability, efficiency and sustainability.

Our Supplier Quality & Development function supports Procurement and Manufacturing through both preventative and reactive supplier quality measures. Operating as a global organisation across businesses and regions, the team develops and provides common standards, processes and tools that help ensure the quality and reliable delivery of purchased goods. In this role, you will work across this global network to strengthen alignment, accelerate improvement and support the continued maturity of Supplier Quality & Development.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably.

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fuelled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character, no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

26 days holiday, increasing to 29 days with time served.
Access to a flexible benefits portal, including private medical cover and cycle-to-work schemes.
A class-leading adjustable pension scheme.
Career development and continuous learning opportunities.
Exposure to strategic transformation programs across a global industrial organisation.
The opportunity to influence how Supplier Quality & Development operates across businesses and regions worldwide.

Project Manager (PMP) – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP Implementation

Position:
Project Manager (PMP) – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP Implementation
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of a multi-entity ERP integration and change management program. This role is responsible for consolidating multiple operating businesses onto a single ERP platform ( Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central with an industry-specific layer/ Integrator ), while driving the people-side of change across finance, operations, sales, procurement, and warehouse teams.
The successful candidate will bring proven experience running Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP implementations or migrations that span multiple legal entities, business units, and legacy systems, and will thrive in a fast-paced merger and integration environment.
Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery
•
Own the full project lifecycle — initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure — across all workstreams (Finance, Inventory/Master Data, Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, Reporting).
•
Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, RAID log, budget, and status dashboards.
•
Manage cross-functional resources, external implementation partners, and vendors to hit milestones on time and on budget.
•
Facilitate steering committee, sponsor, and working group meetings — including agendas, minutes, and follow-ups.

ERP & Systems Expertise
•
Lead requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, and business process design across multiple entities.
•
Coordinate master data strategy (item, customer, vendor, GL, UOM) and standardization across businesses.
•
Oversee data migration, cutover planning, UAT, hypercare, and go-live activities.
•
Partner with IT and the implementation vendor on configuration, integrations, and reporting.

Multi-Business Integration
•
Align processes and policies across multiple acquired or sister companies, balancing standardization with local business needs.
•
Manage stakeholder relationships across finance, operations, sales, warehouse, and executive leadership at each site.
•
Support synergy tracking, site transitions, and harmonization of workflows post-merger.

Change Management & Governance
•
Build and execute the change management plan — stakeholder analysis, communication plan, training strategy, and adoption metrics.
•
Develop governance frameworks, RACI charts, one-pagers, and SOPs to embed sustainable practices.
•
Lead training, super-user programs, and knowledge transfer to end users.
•
Champion a culture of process discipline, data governance, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required
•
5–8+ years of Project Management experience, with at least 2 full-cycle ERP implementations or migrations delivered. Prefereably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central,
•
Demonstrated experience managing ERP projects across multiple business entities, sites, or acquired companies.
•
Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, NetSuite, SAP, or comparable mid-market ERP. Industry-specific layers (e.g., food/seafood, distribution) an asset.
•
Strong understanding of core business processes: Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory & Warehouse, Finance/GL, Master Data Management.
•
Proven ability to lead change management initiatives — communications, training, adoption, and stakeholder engagement.
•
Advanced skills in MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams/SharePoint.
•
PMP, Prince2, or equivalent certification preferred; Prosci / CCMP change certification is a strong asset.

Core Competencies
•
Executive presence and strong stakeholder management
•
Structured thinker — able to translate ambiguity into a clear plan
•
Change leader — empathetic communicator who drives adoption
•
Detail-oriented with strong governance and documentation discipline
•
Resilient and collaborative in fast-moving integration environments

Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada
